core_rules: Ledger is source/planning memory, not canonical Plans.
Every substantive PRD Builder and Planning Wizard product turn writes its ledger before state advances.
Live non-pipeline Plans docs become canonical only after explicit ledger-to-Plans compilation.
Use PRD Builder and Planning Wizard as canonical product names.
Use mandatory parallel read-only subagents for broad extraction, compilation review, and audits; controller is sole canonical writer.
No unapproved stubs, TODOs, TBDs, placeholders, empty required sections, fake acceptance criteria, or deferred implementation details.
The bootstrap compile phase does not create WorkNodes, NodeSeeds, executable queues, implementation files, GoalRuns, or production build tasks.
Approve And Build is a finished-product runtime command, not an action performed while compiling this bootstrap ledger.
A compile-ready cursor is not compile authorization; compilation requires an explicit user instruction.
